On Tuesday, August 25, 2015 at 10:32:10 AM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
Is there some way to enforce dependencies on a particular
version in R?
Yes, we currently depend on R >= 3.02

What happens if two R packages depend on
different versions of another library?

Usually dependencies are of the >= form, in which case it should install the tighter dependency.

But I don't know what either of these questions has to do with this weird path handling on a Mac. The makefile for rstan has CXXFLAGS and for some reason was looking in the named directories in an unexpected order.

Ben
